rationale: Collision tolerance functions but its accepted x interval is wider than the visible paddle and ball, so contact feedback misrepresents placement. Source-derived valid contact at x .12,y .86,z .08 has69.108designpx separation vs racket~41.62+ball12, proving a15.49px horizontal gap. Not a gameplay crash or critical operation failure; scope rendering to existing model/projection instead of narrowing easy-play physics solely for fixture. Net hardcoded drawn height also differs from model projected plane; same renderer correspondence issue, observed after API and recorded separately without retroactively editing submitted state.
